# Vanilla Java Edition 1.8 command names.
#
# Source: source/java/1.8/language.json in the minecraft-protocol repository,
# the client language file shipped with the game. Every line below is derived
# from a commands.<name>.usage key in it: the name is the first token of the
# usage line and the usage line is reproduced verbatim.
#
# Captured 2026-08-18 by reading that file, not by running a server and paging
# through /help, which is what the plan called for. The language file is an
# upstream artifact that can be diffed and re-derived; a transcript of /help is
# neither, and typing the list from memory would have been worse than both.
#
# What is NOT here: aliases. The language file has one usage key per command,
# so /msg and /w do not appear beside /tell even though 1.8 accepts all three.
# The aliases are hand-listed in stubs.go and marked as such, so the next person
# knows which half of this list has an upstream source and which does not.
#
# A command whose usage line has subcommands (/scoreboard, /worldborder) is
# listed once, with the shortest of its usage lines — the one that names the
# command's own shape rather than one branch of it.
#
# Format: <name>\t<vanilla usage line>
achievement	/achievement <give|take> <stat_name|*> [player]
ban	/ban <name> [reason ...]
ban-ip	/ban-ip <address|name> [reason ...]
banlist	/banlist [ips|players]
blockdata	/blockdata <x> <y> <z> <dataTag>
chunkinfo	/chunkinfo [<x> <y> <z>]
clear	/clear [player] [item] [data] [maxCount] [dataTag]
clone	/clone <x1> <y1> <z1> <x2> <y2> <z2> <x> <y> <z> [maskMode] [cloneMode]
debug	/debug <start|stop>
defaultgamemode	/defaultgamemode <mode>
deop	/deop <player>
difficulty	/difficulty <new difficulty>
effect	/effect <player> clear
enchant	/enchant <player> <enchantment ID> [level]
entitydata	/entitydata <entity> <dataTag>
execute	/execute <entity> <x> <y> <z> <command>
fill	/fill <x1> <y1> <z1> <x2> <y2> <z2> <TileName> [dataValue] [oldBlockHandling] [dataTag]
gamemode	/gamemode <mode> [player]
gamerule	/gamerule <rule name> [value]
give	/give <player> <item> [amount] [data] [dataTag]
help	/help [page|command name]
kick	/kick <player> [reason ...]
kill	/kill [player|entity]
list	/list
me	/me <action ...>
op	/op <player>
pardon	/pardon <name>
pardon-ip	/pardon-ip <address>
particle	/particle <name> <x> <y> <z> <xd> <yd> <zd> <speed> [count] [mode]
playsound	/playsound <sound> <player> [x] [y] [z] [volume] [pitch] [minimumVolume]
publish	/publish
replaceitem	/replaceitem <entity|block> ...
save-all	/save-all
save-off	/save-off
save-on	/save-on
say	/say <message ...>
scoreboard	/scoreboard teams list [name]
seed	/seed
setblock	/setblock <x> <y> <z> <TileName> [dataValue] [oldBlockHandling] [dataTag]
setidletimeout	/setidletimeout <Minutes until kick>
setworldspawn	/setworldspawn [<x> <y> <z>]
spawnpoint	/spawnpoint [player] [<x> <y> <z>]
spreadplayers	/spreadplayers <x> <z> <spreadDistance> <maxRange> <respectTeams true|false> <player ...>
stats	/stats <entity|block> ...
stop	/stop
summon	/summon <EntityName> [x] [y] [z] [dataTag]
tell	/tell <player> <private message ...>
tellraw	/tellraw <player> <raw json message>
testfor	/testfor <player> [dataTag]
testforblock	/testforblock <x> <y> <z> <TileName> [dataValue] [dataTag]
testforblocks	/testforblocks <x1> <y1> <z1> <x2> <y2> <z2> <x> <y> <z> [mode]
time	/time <set|add|query> <value>
title	/title <player> <title|subtitle|clear|reset|times> ...
toggledownfall	/toggledownfall
tp	/tp [target player] <destination player>
trigger	/trigger <objective> <add|set> <value>
weather	/weather <clear|rain|thunder> [duration in seconds]
whitelist	/whitelist add <player>
worldborder	/worldborder center <x> <z>
xp	/xp <amount> [player]
